title: The Web Full of Rain Beads
youtube_title: The Web Full of Rain Beads | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet noticing is a way of being gentle with the world.
summary: At a library aisle with a slice of sun, Kira finds a web holding rain beads in a row. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Kira shows Brisa how to look without disturbing it. Nana Ruth looks too, and they leave it where it is.
